prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a premium original enemy illustration for a Chinese industrial fantasy action RPG, codex portrait and production character design. Generate ONE creature only, full body in three-quarter view, genuine transparent background with clean alpha, no floor, no pedestal, no environment, no cast ground shadow. Subject M01 Rustfang Delver: a hunched, triangular-silhouette abandoned mining automaton animated by tiny mineral-organic filaments. One arm is a very long asymmetrical iron pickaxe clearly raised ready for a heavy sweeping strike; the other is a short stout gripping claw. Its head is an inverted battered mining lamp, a small warm amber slit under a protective metal hood instead of a human face. Heavy hunched shoulder shell, compact body, two short articulated digging legs firmly planted, visible joints and mining-tool mechanisms; menace through beautiful readable shape design. Creature is cohesive salvaged iron/mineral construction with sparse subtle underground biological binding at seams, not humanoid armor. Richly hand-painted stylized industrial-fantasy rendering, elegant deliberate edges, believable worn layered materials, oxidized iron, charcoal steel, scratched ochre enamel, leather-like mineral tendons, small glowing warm core and fine dust caught on its body. Dramatic soft volumetric painterly key light, readable shadow shapes, restrained highlights. Entire body and long pick fit with 8 percent clear margin; substantial detail that still reads at small gameplay scale. Original distinctive design, no resemblance to an existing franchise. No text, labels, logos, UI, watermarks, decorative frame, extra characters, extra weapons, base or backdrop.
visual_language: Original industrial fantasy: salvaged mining mechanisms fused with mineral-organic growth; rust, charcoal, scratched ochre enamel, restrained amber cores.

alpha_validation.notes: Source PNG alpha preserved without external editing. Near-opaque subject pixels are expected from generated output; this is an illustration, not an animation sheet.

production_status: Original transparent concept illustration ready for bestiary/presentation integration. Directional gameplay animation sheets and attack/recovery poses remain separate deliverables.
